Overview.Name: Saicharan
Overview.Goal: Looking better (appearance), Feeling energetic & confident, Preventing/reversing health issues, Mental wellbeing & stress reduction, Reducing body fat and improving physique
Overview.Preference_Notes: Minimal non-veg, mostly vegetarian, avoids non-veg on Tuesday

Meal_1: Option 1: Paneer pan fried (120 g) + cucumber slices
Option 2: Egg omelette (2 eggs) + cooked vegetables
Option 3: RICE RAWA upma (~150 g) + curd
Meal_2: Option 1: Cooked rice (150 g) & paneer curry (120 g)
Option 2: Cooked rice (150 g) & egg curry (2 eggs)
Meal_3 (Main Dinner Meal): Option 1: Cooked rice (150 g) & chicken curry (120 g) + vegetable curry
Option 2: Cooked rice (150 g) & fish curry (120 g)
Option 3: Cooked rice (150 g) & paneer curry (120 g)

Notes_and_Tips: Reduce fried foods and late-night snacking to improve fat loss.
Start meals with paneer, eggs or chicken before eating rice.
Get 20–30 minutes of morning sunlight exposure daily.
Aim for a short walk after dinner to improve recovery and digestion.
Consistent meal timing and sleep will improve body composition and energy.
